purpose: New complete v2 train trajectories for paired memory engineering pilot; no confirmation or adoption.
scope: Five constructed workflows on independently grouped real receipt scans in one domain; actual text and source-image crop outputs

source_selection.order: SHA256(study_id:role:source_group); one receipt per group ordered by SHA256(study_id:episode_group)
source_selection.tuning_source_role: train, after and disjoint from the 40 model-fitting groups
source_selection.disclosed_source_exclusion: Exclude every nontrain source group in the independently pinned public-source-exposure ledger before pilot selection; retain old registration bytes and quarantine the entire exposed confirmation group
source_selection.confirmation_release: DENIED pending externally authenticated owner, model/comparator locks and prospective power plan

independent_fit_unit: One full from-initialization training replicate per seed; episode seeds and common behavior collector are not independent fits

training.common_data: Actual isolated train-only OCR observations, then actual predeclared exploration trajectories using a separately fitted behavior collector
training.training_phase_bound: Finite 152-job grid; each subprocess is bounded. The 7200-second admission timer applies to episode phases, not a separate global training timer.
training.frozen: Actual same-content weights per core/seed across controllers; all content tensors frozen and hashed
training.joint: Matched per-controller initialization/data/opportunity; real task and observed utility/transition/router losses in the same backward pass
training.unmatched_active_parameter_claim: Report actual stored/trainable/executed capacities. Do not pad unused parameters or claim legacy exact-active-capacity admission.
training.common_auxiliary_losses: Unused controller heads may receive the same fitted-data opportunity with detached content; count their complete training work

exploration_selection: SHA256(case_id) modulo three, before viewing any private score; remove operations forbidden by public committed outputs

objective.gross: Externally pinned exact-answer / actual-pixel-crop rubric in [0,1]
objective.weight_rationale: Prospective research latency trade-off: 100 seconds costs one full quality unit. This is not a provider price, energy conversion, or production owner approval.
objective.failed_deployment_decision_utility: -1 - 0.01 * observed_deployment_wall_seconds; preserve gross_score=null when external scoring did not occur
objective.retention_scope: Held-out receipt field retrieval; compare each joint A/B/C/D both to its frozen counterpart and to the same-seed/core pretrained content decoder actually executing WRITE_TEXT then STOP. No claim about unmeasured historic multimodal abilities.

budgets.phase_budget_semantics: Stop new episode admissions before the 7200-second deadline; drain already admitted episodes within the declared 360-second bound. This is not a hard total phase kill timer.
budgets.failed_originals: Always retained; any explicit infrastructure correction gets a new operation ID and predecessor. No failed attempt disappears.

tuning.criterion: Highest mean net latency utility, equally weighted source groups and five families, on the disjoint eight train-role tuning groups
tuning.strongest_comparator: Per fit/regime choose the strongest tuned member of initial/tuned_fixed/voi/mpc on either ordinary or Hepta core, before any development pilot execution; retain the original 16 profiles plus 8 same-Hepta supplementary profiles
tuning.initial_delivery: No learned policy choice or extra encoding; exact same incoming delivery and model-loading accounting

statistics.bootstrap: Paired within fit/source, equal family weights, resample independent fits and source groups separately; 20000 draws, seed 32452843; Bonferroni 24 descriptive intervals
statistics.power: Estimate fit, source and interaction variance from actual pilot; prospective future mean variance vf/R + vs/G + vi/(R*G). Superiority assumes true net gain .10 against the useful-effect null .05, giving gap .05; retention assumes true difference 0 against null -.02, giving gap .02. Never fit the planning alternative to observed gains, invent variance, or reuse pilot fits/groups as confirmation.
statistics.missing_or_failed_runs: Retain all planned rows and failures; report coverage, failure penalties and missing measurement. Formal gates remain HOLD.

research_accounting.double_count_rule: Research includes its actual evaluation inference. Do not add the same deployment envelope again when totaling research. Nested costs are reconciled, never summed twice.

native_boundary: A research Cell journal and actual incumbent next inference do not authenticate three independent controlling authorities or constitute protected FinalUse consumption
permitted_outcome: Inconclusive or Failed; no scientific adoption, no zero-delta V5 update, no relaxation of no-op or positive-gain rules
